message: Leon, I appreciate you reaching out, but I can't do this one. Amon-Ra St. Brown's a top-shelf receiver and Keenan Allen's a solid vet, but those two aren't close to even - I'd be shortchanging my own team if I said yes, and that's not how we run things here. If you want to talk about a deal that's fair to both sides, my door's open. This one isn't it.
